quest.title: A Story for You
quest.description: "Today, me and Albedo arrived in a country where there's lots and lots of thunder. Albedo said that this place is called Inazuma... Inazuma... Klee thinks this name is pretty hard to write."
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x40, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Iwao
dialogues.text: #Hey {F#ma'am}{M#mister}, do you really know how to make Egg Rolls?

dialogues.speaker: Iwao
dialogues.text: If you're not confident in your cooking skills, you can always go buy them from Shimura Kanbei's shop instead. I promise I won't make fun of you for it.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: What a coincidence. I was wondering where I might be able to find you, and here you are.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Hehe, can't I come and see you when nothing is up?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Alright, as much as I'd like to sit and chat with you, this time I'm here mainly for Klee.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Before bringing Klee here, I told her many stories about Inazuma. It got her very excited to experience the local culture here.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: However, I've got other things to do in Inazuma this time besides painting the portraits of The Five Kasen. Over the next couple of days, I won't have the time to show her around.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Inazuma is not like Mondstadt. I can't just let Klee wander off by herself when I'm busy with other things. So, I had to have her stay at the International Trade Association while I finish my work.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: She hasn't complained, but I can tell she's not enjoying being stuck there on her own.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Fortunately, I now have you and Paimon. So...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Yay, {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight's here!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Whatcha talkin' about, {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight? Are we gonna go play?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Klee, are you saying you'd like to go and play?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yeah! ...Um, but Albedo is really busy. I can't go too far away, or he'll be worried about me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Aw, Klee, you're such a thoughtful kid.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Unlike Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah! Paimon's very thoughtful, thank you very much! Paimon always thinks of you whenever she's eating a delicious slime.

choices.text: Well, that settles it. You're very thoughtful.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway — it is pretty cruel not to let Klee go out when she was so excited to come here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We'll look after Klee.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yup yup, allow the almighty {NICKNAME} and dependable Paimon to bring Klee on a tour of Inazuma.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: #Klee, do you wanna go play with {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yay! You bet I do!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: As you know, Klee is our Spark Knight. You must keep her safe and sound.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Ahem... by which I mean, try to keep her out of trouble.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: For instance, if a mountain in Inazuma was to lose one if its peaks, or if there were an explosion somewhere in the city, Klee could very well get in trouble...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Got it. No explosions.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Glad to hear it.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I promise I'll bring you back an awesome souvenir, Mr. Albedo.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Great, I look forward to it.

choices.text: Let's introduce her to someone interesting.
Ok, fine: Paimon, you are very thoughtful.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, that's more like it.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Yes, indeed, I believe Klee has missed you tremendously.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Wow, something smells so good... I think it's coming from this steaming thingy.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #{F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight, look at this noodley soup, it's so pretty! There's so many nice things inside.

dialogues.speaker: Iwao
dialogues.text: It's not "noodley soup." It's "Tonkotsu Ramen," actually.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Oh... so, um, what are those yellow-and-red thingies on that plate?

dialogues.speaker: Iwao
dialogues.text: You're kidding, right? Those are Tri-Flavored Skewers.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: And what about this little yellow cake?

dialogues.speaker: Iwao
dialogues.text: That's an Egg Roll. They're amazing. Have you really not tried one before?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Wow, Tonkotsu Ramen, Tri-Flavored Skewers, and Egg Rolls... They all sound delicious.

dialogues.speaker: Iwao
dialogues.text: Hehehe, they sure are. Guess you're not from around here if you haven't tried any of these before.

dialogues.speaker: Iwao
dialogues.text: Lemme buy you an Egg Roll with my allowance so you can get a taste of our Inazuman food.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Really? But Master Jean said I shouldn't go taking other people's things.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Also, that's your allowance, right? Taking another kid's allowance just seems kinda wrong...

response.speaker: Iwao
response.text: Ohh... I remember you, you're Yoimiya's friend. How come you know how to make Egg Rolls?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Egg Rolls are a piece of cake for {NICKNAME}. Why don't you make some for Klee and Iwao?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure — and I'll throw in some for you too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #R—Really? Wow, Paimon is so touched. You're learning, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, we'll be waiting on those Egg Rolls.

dialogues.speaker: Iwao
dialogues.text: #Wow, you really can cook them. You're awesome, {F#ma'am}{M#mister}.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Mmm... it's sweet... so yummy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #...Yup yup, it's delicious... {NICKNAME}, you are the best.

dialogues.speaker: Iwao
dialogues.text: Yeah, these Egg Rolls are pretty good... but I still think Yoimiya's are better.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Who is Yoimiya? She makes Egg Rolls, too?

response.speaker: Iwao
response.text: Yoimiya can do anything! She tells stories, keeps goldfish, makes fireworks, and gives us candy, too.

response.speaker: Iwao
response.text: Yoimiya's pretty much the best and most awesome person ever.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #For me, the best and most awesome person in the world is my mom! And Klee knows loads of other great people, too, like Mr. Albedo, {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight, Master Jean, Kaeya...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Surely she's not going to name everyone she knows...?

response.speaker: Iwao
response.text: Oh... well, I don't know any of those people. But anyways, I still wanna introduce you to Yoimiya. If you want, I'll take you to find her.

response.speaker: Iwao
response.text: In most festivals, Yoimiya's so busy that you can never find her. But this festival's different — she has free time, so she can play with us.

response.speaker: Iwao
response.text: She seems like she hasn't been in a great mood recently, but maybe seeing you will cheer her up.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Okay, let's go play with Yoimiya.

dialogues.speaker: Matsuzaka
dialogues.text: Yoimiya, don't be sad. Um... I... oh, I know, lemme tell you something that'll cheer you up!

dialogues.speaker: Matsuzaka
dialogues.text: Yesterday, I won three beetle fights in a row against that guy with the horns on his head!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Wow, Matsuzaka, nice work! It's not easy to beat Itto...

dialogues.speaker: Saika
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Yoimiya, maybe you can't light fireworks during the Irodori Festival, but there are still lots of other fun things to do!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I know... Thanks, you guys, it's just that fireworks are banned in the city for a few days. I'm not that upset, really.

dialogues.speaker: Iwao
dialogues.text: Yoimiya, it's me!

dialogues.speaker: Iwao
dialogues.text: I wanna introduce you to a new friend. An outlander girl, I just met her... Wait, what's your name again?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Klee, my name is Klee.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Nice to meet you, Klee. I'm Yoimiya, and I run Naganohara Fireworks.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Um... hello...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I love the cute outfit, with the hat, and that cool little symbol, so unique. And your backpack — wow, it's really well-made.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: That's a four-leaf clover. Mom and Master Jean said it can bring me good luck.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Really? That's awesome. I bet everyone would love one of those.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Also, that little fairy on your backpack is super cute, too.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: That's Dodoco, my best friend. We always go fish blasting together in Starfell Lake.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Oh, Dodoco? What an interesting name. I really like it.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yep. My mom says that when a Dodoco is born, it rides the wind and goes off on a big adventure.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: "Ride the wind and go off on a big adventure." Klee, your mom sounds like a very cool person.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yep! My mom is the best and most awesome person ever.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: And, Yoimiya, Iwao was right. You're a really cool person, too.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hehe, thanks, Klee, I feel like we really get each other. We'll be great friends, I'm sure of it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's so heartwarming watching these two chat away.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hey, Klee, since you like four-leaf clovers so much, why don't I make a firework with a four-leaf clover pattern and set it off for you?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yeah! And after the fireworks, we can go fish blasting with Dodoco.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, hold on a second, fish blasting? No way, Albedo was pretty clear about that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No explosions allowed.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Oops. I got so excited that I completely forgot about that.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: The folks from the Yashiro Commission specifically warned me that no fireworks are allowed in Inazuma during the Irodori Festival.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: What? It's not allowed? But, awww... okay then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, come on, you just made a new friend, this is a happy occasion. Why are you suddenly so upset?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't be sad.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we still have loads of things we can do!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go check out the Irodori Festival.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right. Just like Saika said, there are lots of fun things to do.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: What do you say, Klee? Sounds like the Irodori Festival could be a real blast!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Okay then, let's go!

talks.objective: Accompany Yoimiya and Klee to see the Irodori Festival
Accompany Yoimiya and Klee to see the Irodori Festival

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Thank you for taking care of Klee.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I heard lighting fires is strictly prohibited in both Ritou and Inazuma during the Irodori Festival. Please keep a close watch on her.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Klee's already run off. You'd better catch up with her.

talks.objective: Accompany Yoimiya and Klee to see the Irodori Festival

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: "Outlander Brigade: When the Wind of Death Blew Towards the Blond Samurai"...? What a long name... Must be a new one, I've never heard of it.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: By... Kawabunga Icky. Yoimiya, this is a really strange name.

dialogues.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
dialogues.text: Who's this "Kawabunga"? It's pronounced "Kayabuki Ikkei." Heh... that would be me.

dialogues.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
dialogues.text: Outlander Brigade is a new series of mine, and When the Wind of Death Blew Towards the Blond Samurai is the first volume.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Outlander's Big... Raid... um, is it a story about the best of friends?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Kaeya says that every good story has to have best friends in it.

dialogues.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
dialogues.text: Absolutely not. I would never allow such clichés in one of my novels.

dialogues.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
dialogues.text: This is a book about betrayal, blood, and tears! A long and lonely struggle! A stubborn samurai's path to the truth! This is the kind of story that needs to be told.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Oh... is that right? Well, I'm not sure that's a very suitable story for Klee. Um... we might keep looking around.

dialogues.speaker: Kayabuki Ikkei
dialogues.text: Hey, Miss, don't go! Are you sure you don't want a copy? I'll give you 40% off!

talks.objective: Accompany Yoimiya and Klee to see the Irodori Festival
Accompany Yoimiya and Klee to see the Irodori Festival
Accompany Yoimiya and Klee to see the Irodori Festival
Accompany Yoimiya and Klee to see the Irodori Festival

dialogues.speaker: Iwao
dialogues.text: I still don't get why Yoimiya is upset...

dialogues.speaker: Saika
dialogues.text: Ugh, dummy, Yoimiya is upset because she can't set off fireworks for everyone during the Irodori Festival.

talks.objective: Accompany Yoimiya and Klee to see the Irodori Festival

dialogues.speaker: Matsuzaka
dialogues.text: It's alright, I know Yoimiya's upset because she can't light any fireworks. You should go with her to the Irodori Festival.

dialogues.speaker: Matsuzaka
dialogues.text: I'm gonna take my strongest Onikabuto and go beat that guy with the horns on his head in a beetle battle again. I'll cheer Yoimiya up in my own way.

talks.objective: Accompany Yoimiya and Klee to see the Irodori Festival
Accompany Yoimiya and Klee to see the Irodori Festival

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Flowers for Princess Fischl... Oh, look, it's Fischl's story.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: That's right, Flowers for Princess Fischl. Have you read this book before, Klee?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Nope. But I know Fischl's story.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Fischl always hangs out with Oz. Everyone in the Adventurers' Guild knows, it's just like how me and Dodoco are always together.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I wonder if... Dodoco is getting bored now?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Klee, I'm afraid it can't be helped. There are a lot of flammable items at the festival, and we have to be careful not to start a fire.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Darn, it seems like even the Irodori Festival can't cheer Klee and Yoimiya up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... there must be plenty of things you can do with Dodoco besides lighting fireworks and going fish blasting.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Yeah! Like, um... uh...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Wait, so that's what you're suggesting?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yeah, the Irodori Festival is the perfect occasion for storytelling.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! The Irodori Festival is a place for putting your work on display. You could show Dodoco's story for everyone here...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Think of it like Dodoco playing with everybody.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bingo! What do you think of that idea, Klee?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Mr. Albedo taught me how to paint! I can paint the story of Dodoco's adventure in Inazuma!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: That's very imaginative. I think it's a great idea!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hehe, we can even put the finished story on display at the festival.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yay, great! Dodoco will be so happy.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Perfect. Okay, so I have some paper, paintbrushes, and paint at the shop. Let's go to the shop and paint your story there.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yay! Let's go, let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Klee and I just had a discussion, and we've decided...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: We're gonna keep the content of this story a secret from you guys for now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Why?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Ugh, obviously I can't tell you why, or... You'll see, don't worry.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: You can keep exploring the festival while we're busy in the shop. We'll be here when you get back.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Come on, Yoimiya, we should get going. Let's go inside and start painting.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Yoimiya and Klee enter the shop.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww, Paimon was hoping that we could all paint together... So unfair!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heehee, actually, Paimon's got an idea! Come on, let's go around to the windows and take a sneaky peek.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: So. What does Dodoco do after getting to Inazuma?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Um, Dodoco goes to eat Tri-Flavored Skewers, Tonkotsu Ramen, and Egg Rolls.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Ooh, that sounds great. Is that what you're painting? It looks beautiful!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Once you're done painting, let's go get it printed. We'll print a whole bunch of copies and go hand them out at the festival.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hmm, although it'll cost a lot of Mora to get it printed. Let me see if I've got enough saved up...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: It's okay, Yoimiya, I have some Mora! Look!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: 50 Mora is probably not quite enough...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: #Well, if we don't have enough, we can ask {NICKNAME} for ideas.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #{F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight has helped a lot already. I don't wanna trouble {F#her}{M#him}.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: So I think I should just go fish blasting to earn some Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: #No fish blasting! Paimon and {NICKNAME} said so.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Oh... then we've got no choice. We'll have to go see Mr. Albedo.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Who's Mr. Albedo?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: He's my older brother. He's super-duper smart, he can do anything!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: And he knows how to paint, too. He paints hilichurls, Kaeya, and even Dodoco. That's why he came to Inazuma this time, to do paintings for everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Is that right? Then I guess Mr. Albedo must be an artist working with the Yae Publishing House.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: An artist? Oh, that means he has two jobs... One as an alchemy-ist, teaching Sucrose alchemy, and the other as an artist, doing paintings for people.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yoimiya, lemme show you something. Mr. Albedo taught me you can paint Dodoco's color like this...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Wow, I can see the resemblance. Alright, I'll paint the streets, and Klee, you fill in Dodoco's colors.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: ...Hey, you can even write the story over here to explain what's happening in the painting.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Okay! Let's write this...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shoot, Paimon didn't hear the last part.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A while later.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Dodoco sure had a lot of fun in Inazuma!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Those two sound like they really did go on an adventure with Dodoco. They couldn't be happier.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Now we have to get Dodoco's story printed. C'mon, let's go to the Yae Publishing House.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Here we are. This is the Yae Publishing House.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yae Publishing House... Ooh, it's Aunty Aratani! I know Aunty Aratani!

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: Aunty? Who's that calling me Aunty? Oh, it's the little girl who came with Mr. Calx.

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: How can I help you, little girl?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Aunty Aratani, can you help me get Dodoco's story printed so that everybody can see it?

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: Dodoco? Oh, so you've been writing a story, huh? Is Dodoco the main character?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Not only that, Dodoco is also real. Look!

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: Huh, I don't quite understand...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'd better explain this to her.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You explain Dodoco's identity and Klee and Yoimiya's wish to Aratani.

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: Oh, I see. I'd love to help you make this wish come true, but I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: The deadline has passed for accepting printing orders for the Irodori Festival.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Aunty, are you saying Dodoco won't be able to meet everyone after all?

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, little girl.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: *sobbing*

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: #Aw Klee, don't be upset. You still have me and {NICKNAME}. We'll think of something!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, we'll find a way.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Um, Miss Aratani, is there any way at all we can still get this printed?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: We can pay extra! And if you're short on staff to help with the printing, I can pitch in!

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: Miss Yoimiya, I understand your sentiment, but I'm afraid it's not as simple as that.

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: We've been printing many people's personal works for this festival, and a lot of the books are already well behind schedule. The printing press is already working overtime to try and catch up.

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: At a time like this, we really can't squeeze any more jobs in.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do we do? Seems like we might have to give up on this idea...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: No, I won't let that happen.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I remember this one time when I was little, pops said he'd take me to the festival, but he was so busy with work that he forgot all about it.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I waited and waited, and kept wondering when pops was finally gonna take me there. Eventually, people started coming home from the festival...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: That night, I cried miserably. To this day, I still remember how sad I felt. I don't want Klee to feel the same way.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: If we can't get it printed, then we'll just have to find our own way!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I can paint. Over the next few days, I'll paint as many as I can, then we'll take those to the festival!

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: My, my. Yoimiya has quite a determined spirit. I like it very much.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's Miko! And Albedo too!

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: We heard everything.

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: Oh, Lady Yae...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: It's okay, I know. You were just following the rules. Plus, we really are quite behind schedule with the printing.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: But our mission at Yae Publishing House is to brings dreams and happiness to the masses. It would be a crying shame if we couldn't even help one adorable little girl fulfill her wish.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Let me think... Oh, I know!

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Yoimiya, little girl, you can print your book, but on one condition. Okay?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Of course, Lady Guuji. Just tell us. Whatever this condition is, I am ready to face it.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Dear me, it's nothing that horrendous. You make it sound like I'm some sort of wicked witch.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: All I mean is, if you want to get your work printed now, there is only one way: You have to combine it with another print.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: However, there is only a small amount of space remaining in the book in question. Your book is too big, so you have to reduce it to about half the size to make it fit.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Is this a sacrifice that you are willing to make?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Klee, Lady Guuji is saying that we can print the book if we shrink it to half the size. Are you okay with that?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Yep, I am! Thanks, Miss Guuji Lady!

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hehe, what an adorable little girl. Well, that settles it. Aratani, make sure it gets printed with tonight's batch!

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: Yes, Lady Yae. I'll get right on it!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Combining the prints is a plausible solution, but it'll cause a lot of extra work for the printing press. I am terribly sorry about that.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: No problem. Just think of it as my greeting gift for little Klee.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Besides, the Yae Publishing House will need your help with the illustrations again next time, Mr. Calx. You could also consider it as my investment in you.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Alright, I won't disturb you two any longer. Bye-bye, now.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Yay! Everything worked out perfectly. Now we just need to wait for an update from the Yae Publishing House.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: #Yoimiya, {NICKNAME}, thank you for keeping Klee so exceptionally well entertained for me.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hehe, no worries!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You should spend some time with Klee too, Albedo.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Yes, you're right. Klee is family, after all.

talks.objective: Wait for printing to finish (14:00 – 16:00 the next day)
Go to the Irodori Festival site

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #Look, {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight! Aunty Aratani brought us Dodoco's story!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now we can finally see what secrets Klee and Yoimiya were keeping from us.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: It's really nothing that exciting.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: It's the story of Dodoco and me...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: And me...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: And you guys.

choices.text: You put me in the story?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's in the story, too! This is Paimon's first time featuring in a printed book. Woohoo, Paimon's gonna be famous!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Of course we included Paimon. This is the story of everyone's big, happy adventure with Dodoco.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #This story is me and Yoimiya's gift for {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Lady Yae wanted me to inform you that since this book was printed together with another work, there are many more copies than you may have anticipated.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: We won't charge you a printing fee, but in exchange, the extra copies of your book will be included as a free gift with purchases of the other book. Is that okay with you?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Oh, are you sure? It's fine by us, but what does the author of the book think...

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Actually, the book that yours was printed with is called the "Teyvat Travel Guide."

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Hey! That's Mommy's book!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: So Klee's mother is a writer? Huh.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Klee's mother, Alice, is a renowned adventurer in Teyvat, and the Inazuma Edition of her popular "Teyvat Travel Guide" series is set to be released imminently.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Lady Yae has already decided on how to promote it: "A joint endeavor by Teyvat's biggest and best mother-daughter adventure duo." It's sure to be a huge hit.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, Paimon knew it! Miko would never do anything for free...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hehe, a typical move by Lady Yae. It works out well for everybody, doesn't it?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yep, I'm super happy 'cause my book gets to be released together with mommy's book. It's like me and mommy going on an adventure together.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I am so glad I came. The Irodori Festival is the best!

choices.text: You put me and Paimon in the story?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #{F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight, what do Egg Rolls taste like?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There are loads of cool things to do in Inazuma. Try the local cuisine, visit a shrine... What do you wanna do, Klee?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: "Cuisine"? What's that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, food and drink. Paimon just meant we could take you to a local restaurant.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: A restaurant! Yay! Snack time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Got it! Alright, snack time it is! Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Those two can run so fast when they're motivated. We'd better catch up!
